# Genesis / Paradigm / Project / Epi-Logos — Source Routes

This shelf binds the lexical and cross-register sources used by the [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) and [archaeology](HISTORY.md). It does not make every linked source a warrant for every relation.

## Lexical floor now materialised

- **Genesis / γένεσις:** [LSJ — γένεσις](../../sources/language-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-genesis/lsj-genesis.md), `source_id: lsj-genesis`. Licensed office: origin/source, generation/production/coming-into-being semantic field. The QL `0` appointment and Creativity comparison remain authorial.
- **Paradigm / παράδειγμα / παραδείκνυμι:** [LSJ — παράδειγμα / παραδείκνυμι](../../sources/language-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-paradeigma-paradeiknumi/lsj-paradeigma-paradeiknumi.md), `source_id: lsj-paradeigma-paradeiknumi`. Licensed office: pattern/model/exemplar and exhibit-side-by-side/compare/indicate. “Pattern of disclosure” and the Objective Internality appointment remain authorial.
- **Project root / prōiciō:** [Lewis and Short — prōiciō / projiciō](../../sources/language-philology/lewis-short/lewis-short-proicio/lewis-short-proicio.md), `source_id: lewis-short-proicio`. Licensed office: throw forth/before/out. Projecthood, holography and being-relative-to-a-world remain authorial developments.

The HISTORY page's older “source record pending” wording is therefore superseded for these three lexical floors by this shelf. A historical-dictionary witness for the later English **project / projection** family remains open.

## Native and authorial owners

- [Core theorem](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md): `0`, `/`, `1`, crossed zero, Spanda, 3:3/3:1, dia/syn and return.
- [Symbolon Dynamics](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md): energetic/dynamical and holographic development.
- [A/C](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/AC.md): knower–means–known, ethical ruling and primitive S constitution.
- [C41 Objective Internality](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md): paradigm as lived/enacted mediation of the means.
- [C51 Logos / Epi-Logos](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C51-Logos-Epi-Logos.md): paradigmatic reflexivity / source-return of the account.
- [C56 Compassion](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C56-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins.md) and [A35](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md): ethical manner of return.
- [C64 Paradox](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md): crisis in which the containing relation itself may need to change.

## Śaiva / Indian comparison routes

- [Dyczkowski — Doctrine of Vibration](../../sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md): Spanda, expanded/contracted awareness, manifestation/return and the mirror boundary.
- [Abhinavagupta / Singh — Parā-Trīśikā-Vivaraṇa](../../sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md): Vāk / I-You-It and source-specific Śaiva articulation.
- [C14 Māyā / Operative Measure](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md): revealing/withholding finite horizon. Relation to paradigm is operational homology, never Greek–Sanskrit lexical identity.
- A07/A09 and their sources retain vikalpa/saṃkalpa and tattvic differentiation.

## Projection / image / simulacrum routes

Projecthood must consume these from their actual owners rather than from the Latin lexicon:

- Bimba–Pratibimba and World-Picture / World-Atlas: order of dependence between projection and world.
- A32/C55 Mirror That Moves First: reflection becoming temporally active without becoming its source.
- Baudrillard source house / existing simulacrum relation: projected representation becoming environmental and potentially closing access to source. Exact source passage consumed by Projecthood remains an R3 source-recovery task.

## Phenomenology / projecthood routes still open

The essay's **being-relative-to-a-world** is an authorial development. If Heideggerian projection, Being-in-the-world or thrown projection becomes a historical support rather than a neighbouring comparison, recover the exact German/translated term and passage through the existing Heidegger houses before attributing it.

## Paradigm history still optional

Kuhn is not required to ground the field. If modern scientific “paradigm” history becomes useful, add it as a later historical branch and keep it distinct from both the Greek lexical field and the essay's deeper paradigmatic appointment.

## Return rule

Every consumer must name which operation it takes:

- lexical descent / attested semantic field;
- operational homology;
- authorial QL relational generation;
- historical or philosophical comparison.

A bare occurrence of “paradigm,” “project,” or “genesis” never transfers the whole field's warrant.
